items.title: Minor "Ram" Hall Interview, 1958-09-02
items.q: Sellers, that's about 18 miles out in Yolens.

ctx.x: Sellers, that's about 18 miles out in Yolens. They're going north.
Going north. Up towards Baton Rouge. That's right. Which side of the river? Well, that was, well, let's see. Near Laplace, where Aure was born?
